g:HTMLPanel.p: Headings, lead paragraphs, inline text, quotes and description lists.

d:Example.heading: Headings
d:Example.description: `Heading` writes `h1` to `h6`; `subText` adds faded secondary text.

d:Example.heading: Display headings
d:Example.description: `displaySize` makes a heading larger and lighter, for the top of a page.

d:Example.heading: Lead and paragraphs
d:Example.description: `Lead` makes a paragraph stand out; `Paragraph` takes an `alignment` and an `emphasis` color.

d:Example.heading: Inline text
d:Example.description: Bootstrap styles the inline HTML elements; `Abbreviation` shows its `title` on hover.

d:Example.heading: Blockquotes
d:Example.description: A `BlockQuote` in a `Figure`, with the source in a `FigCaption`.

d:Example.heading: Description lists
d:Example.description: A horizontal `Description` is a grid row: size its titles and data with column classes.
